# moneybin transform

Run data transformations

Generated from the registered command tree, so every option below is one the command declares; `--help` on any command prints the same text. Shared flags, exit codes, and JSON envelopes: [CLI reference](../../guides/cli-reference.md).

Usage: `moneybin transform [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

**Commands**

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`moneybin transform plan`](#moneybin-transform-plan) | Preview pending transform changes (and optionally apply them). |
| [`moneybin transform apply`](#moneybin-transform-apply) | Apply all pending transform changes. |
| [`moneybin transform seed`](#moneybin-transform-seed) | Materialize seed models and propagate to app tables. |
| [`moneybin transform status`](#moneybin-transform-status) | Show current model state and environment. |
| [`moneybin transform validate`](#moneybin-transform-validate) | Check that model SQL parses and resolves without errors. |
| [`moneybin transform audit`](#moneybin-transform-audit) | Run data quality assertions defined in transform models. |
| [`moneybin transform restate`](#moneybin-transform-restate) | Force recompute a model for a date range. |

## moneybin transform plan

Preview pending transform changes (and optionally apply them).

Shows which models would be rebuilt based on changes since the last run.
Use --apply to apply the plan immediately.

Usage: `moneybin transform plan [OPTIONS]`

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--apply, -a` | flag |  | Automatically apply the plan |
| `-o, --output` | one of `text`, `json` | `text` | Output format: 'text' (human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable). |
| `-q, --quiet` | flag |  | Suppress informational output (status lines, progress, ✅). |

## moneybin transform apply

Apply all pending transform changes.

Equivalent to 'moneybin transform plan --apply'. Rebuilds only changed
models since the last run.

Usage: `moneybin transform apply [OPTIONS]`

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-o, --output` | one of `text`, `json` | `text` | Output format: 'text' (human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable). |
| `-q, --quiet` | flag |  | Suppress informational output (status lines, progress, ✅). |

## moneybin transform seed

Materialize seed models and propagate to app tables.

Re-runs the seed step in isolation — useful after editing a seed CSV
or restoring deleted defaults. ``moneybin db init`` and ``moneybin
transform apply`` already run this implicitly.

Usage: `moneybin transform seed [OPTIONS]`

## moneybin transform audit

Run data quality assertions defined in transform models.

Usage: `moneybin transform audit [OPTIONS]`

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--start` | text |  | Required. Start date for audit window (YYYY-MM-DD) |

## moneybin transform restate

Force recompute a model for a date range.

Usage: `moneybin transform restate [OPTIONS]`

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--model` | text |  | Required. Model name (e.g., core.fct_transactions) |
| `--start` | text |  | Required. Start date for restatement (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `--end` | text |  | End date (defaults to today) |
| `--yes, -y` | flag |  | Skip confirmation |
